meta.name: dot-ai-request-dot-ai-feature
meta.description: Generate a feature request prompt for another dot-ai project. Use when you need a feature implemented in a sibling project (MCP server, controller, etc.) to unblock work in the current project.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成跨项目功能请求，推动协作开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在兄弟项目中提功能需求来推进当前项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate cross-project feature requests to unblock development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to request a feature in a sibling project to unblock your current work

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你向另一个 dot-ai 项目（如 MCP 服务器、控制器等）提交功能请求。它会自动生成请求文件并写入目标项目的 tmp 目录，然后提示你审核。
howto.when: 当你需要当前项目依赖的兄弟项目（如 MCP 服务器、控制器等）实现某个功能时，可以触发此技能。

say.text: 请为 dot-ai-controller 项目请求一个新增 API 的功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成请求文件并写入目标项目 tmp 目录。

say.text: 向 dot-ai-ui 请求一个仪表盘可视化新功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you submit a feature request to another dot-ai project (e.g., MCP server, controller). It generates a request file, writes it to the target project's tmp directory, and prompts you to review.
howto.when_en: Trigger this when you need a feature implemented in a sibling project (MCP server, controller, etc.) that your current project depends on.

say_en.text: Request a new API feature for the dot-ai-controller project.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the request file and write it to the target tmp directory.

say_en.text: Request a new dashboard visualization feature for dot-ai-ui.
say_en.note: Claude will create feature-request.md and ask you to review.
